title: Adjudication of the L x S second-order lapse monopole A2(eps) on the uniform-density slice: S9 (eps(3-eps)^2/3, f^rho=-5/2) vs S9c (2(3-eps)^2 required, f^rho=-55/16)

inputs.name: PSU gates S9+S10 (rho-slice map, A2 = eps(3-eps)^2/3, f^rho = 5(2eps-15)/24)
PSU gate S9c (exact separate universe: -5 comoving, 5(eps-7)/8 uniform density; A2 = 2(3-eps)^2 required)
Maldacena 2003 (comoving-gauge ADM constraints, N_1 = zeta_dot/H, d^2 chi = a^2 eps zeta_dot)

reproduction.notes: Deterministic sympy. Part A: exact ADM Hamiltonian + momentum constraints in comoving gauge expanded to second order for two plane waves on the constant-eps growing mode, gradient-free then squeezed limit; solves N_LS = zeta2_dot/H + A2 zeta_L zeta_S; A2 monopole = eps(3-eps)^2/3 (S9), pole eps(3-eps) mu kS/kL odd in mu. Part B: exact local monopole system (Hamiltonian + energy conservation) integrated along a worldline, both final slices: -5 and 5(eps-7)/8 (S9c's separate universe). Part C: shows lambda' weights zeta_2 by 3 lambda (not 2 lambda), reproducing S9's 5(2eps-15)/24 and S9c's gap 5(eps-6)/24 exactly; f_map = -5/8 recomputed from the ADM objects. Verdict written by the script (json key 'verdict').

verification: Re-run and diff the JSON. Required exact values: A2_monopole == 'epsilon*(epsilon - 3)**2/3'; A2_matches == 'S9'; A2_eps_to_0 == '0'; f_phi_local == '-5'; f_rho_local == '5*(epsilon - 7)/8'; lambda_prime_over_lambda == '2'; implied_inin_monopole_dust == '-15/8'; f_map_monopole_rho_normalised == '-5/8'; weight_on_zeta1 == '2 - 2*epsilon/3'; weight_on_zeta2 == '3 - epsilon'; S9_composition_reproduced == '5*(2*epsilon - 15)/24'; gap_S9_minus_true == '5*(epsilon - 6)/24'; the script's asserts all pass.
